answer: A newcomer earns a seat by serving one quarantine season on a named island before the haven opens its gate: each week the newcomer writes one sonnet logging the work done at the quarantine station, and two wardens sign it only after checking the work it names. A sonnet that claims work never done, or a week with no sonnet at all, voids the claim and burns a 500 POA bond. Each season costs a $150 station fee plus a $70 warden fee, so 100 fakes need 100 seasons, $22,000 in fees and 50,000 POA in bonds.
